items.title: Being Forced Out of a Medicare Advantage Plan Was a 1% Event for Years. In 2026 It Hit 10%. The 2027 Letters Must Arrive by October 2. - Yahoo Finance
items.reason: This article reports on a significant regulatory enforcement action or policy change by CMS affecting Medicare Advantage plan disenrollments, which directly impacts payer sanctions and regulatory actions that healthcare revenue-cycle teams must track.
items.summary: Medicare Advantage plan disenrollments have surged dramatically, rising from a historical 1% rate to 10% in 2026, with 2027 disenrollment notices required to be sent by October 2. This sharp increase in forced disenrollments represents a major regulatory enforcement shift by CMS against Medicare Advantage plans, likely reflecting penalties or compliance actions related to network adequacy, quality metrics, or member protections. Revenue-cycle teams must prepare for significant disruption to patient attribution, care coordination, and claims processing as beneficiaries are compulsorily removed from MA plans at unprecedented rates.
